description: Get energy price forecasts from EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO) and other sources. Use when the user asks about price predictions, outlooks, or where oil/gas prices are heading. Returns forecast data available to the account. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.
name: opa_get_forecasts
title: Get Price Forecasts
